caption: The drawing depicts a single male figure standing upright, as well as a smaller head-and-shoulders profile of the same figure at the lower left. He is dressed in a formal, dark gray textured suit consisting of high-waisted trousers and a short, matching jacket with a slightly asymmetrical front closure and wide collar. Underneath the jacket, he wears a white shirt with visible buttons and a pink necktie or cravat. His hands are light brown, and his shoes are black and pointed. The smaller profile view in the lower left corner is rendered in shades of gray and shows the hairstyle and facial features in side view. The background is a plain, off-white color with some light brown discoloration or stains in the corners.
